deviations_from_adr: AC-10/FF-CELL-NO-UUID (ADR §2.5): ADR-текст для formatCellValue(value,'file') читается как синхронный 'originalName | fallback id' (по паттерну person, который честно фолбэчит на id). Реализовано СТРОЖЕ: введён FILE_CELL_ASYNC-сентинел (records-form.js, зеркало RELATION_CELL_ASYNC) — formatCellValue НИКОГДА не возвращает сырой fileVersionId, только сентинел/имя/«—»; имя резолвится асинхронно через листинг записи (GET /api/records/:id/files) в новых компонентах FileCell (список) и FileFieldValue (карточка), по паттерну RelationCell/RelationFieldValue. Причина: AC-9/AC-10/FF-CELL-NO-UUID явно требуют «никогда не показывать сырой uuid», а person может честно фолбэчить на id (не такое же требование в его AC), file — нет. Это ужесточение приёмочного критерия в духе §4.3 (formatCellValue → resolved originalName), не ослабление и не расхождение по объёму.

Тестовый инфраструктурный фикс (src/__tests__/files-http.test.ts): существующий helper httpGet() отбрасывал query-string (path: parsed.pathname без parsed.search) — до T-0579 ни один тест этого файла не использовал query-параметры, поэтому баг был латентным. Без правки AC-11-тесты (?disposition=inline) не могли пройти ни при какой реализации маршрута (клиент их физически не отправлял бы). Правка аддитивна (path: pathname+search); все 19 существовавших тестов файла остаются зелёными без изменения ожиданий (перепроверено).

FIX-FORWARD (review B1): GET /api/records/:recordId/files response gains a `versionIds: string[]` field (PgFileStore.listFilesByRecord + FakeFileStore mirror) — EVERY version id a file has ever had, not just currentVersionId. Additive, non-breaking (existing consumers ignore unknown fields); required to close review m1 honestly (a superseded-but-real fileVersionId must still resolve to its file's name, not read as 'not found').

FIX-FORWARD (review C2/AC-15): the e2e journey-runner's closed StepAction vocabulary had no way to drive a native <select> (Playwright's fill() throws on it — verified empirically) or capture a value from the field-type dropdown needed to author a file-typed field for the new ux-file-field journey. Added ONE new closed-vocabulary action, `selectOption` (types.ts/loader.ts/runner.ts/loader.test.ts/README.md), per this file's own stated 'reviewed extension' convention — not an ad-hoc escape hatch. Also added `combobox` to the RoleName union (native <select> accessible role) so the new journey can target the dropdown by role+name.

FIX-FORWARD (review B1-residual, blocking, 2nd round): adversarial re-check of the review-B1 fix found the registro-only normalization (trim+lowercase, exact `=== "image/svg+xml"` exclusion) still had two live stored-XSS bypasses on BOTH the server read-time boundary (isInlineSafeMime, src/http/files.ts) and its client mirror (isPreviewSafeMime, web/src/screens/screen-record-detail.jsx): [A] a stored mime carrying a parameter (`image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8`, `image/svg+xml;x=1`) survives trim+lowercase AS-IS, fails the exact svg+xml compare, yet still passes a bare `startsWith("image/")` → inline. [B] `image/svg` (no `+xml` suffix) was never covered by the single negative exclusion at all — browsers still render it as SVG. Threat model: the read-time boundary must hold independent of how the mime got into storage — src/core/document-render.ts's addVersion calls (text/html, text/csv, ...) are a SECOND writer that bypasses the upload route's own param-stripping, and `image/svg` needs no parameter to begin with, so any seed/import/writer storing either variant would otherwise leak. FIXED by (1) stripping any `;param` suffix at the comparison boundary on BOTH server and client (`mime.trim().toLowerCase().split(";")[0].trim()`), and (2) replacing the negative svg-exclusion with a POSITIVE allowlist of concrete-safe image subtypes (image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp — INLINE_SAFE_IMAGE_SUBTYPES server-side, PREVIEW_SAFE_IMAGE_SUBTYPES client-side); application/pdf unchanged (inline, now also param-stripped). Any image/* NOT on the allowlist — svg, svg+xml, any parameterized variant, any future/unknown subtype — is denied by construction, closing [A]/[B] and any not-yet-imagined sibling in one move rather than by an exhaustive, ever-growing blocklist.

Adversarial re-check of the prior review-B1 fix found two live stored-XSS bypasses surviving the registro-only normalization: [A] a stored mime carrying a parameter (`image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8`) fails the exact `=== "image/svg+xml"` compare but still passes `startsWith("image/")` → inline; [B] `image/svg` (no `+xml`) was never covered by that single negative exclusion. Both closed on the server (src/http/files.ts isInlineSafeMime) and its client mirror (web/src/screens/screen-record-detail.jsx isPreviewSafeMime) by (1) stripping any `;param` suffix at the comparison boundary and (2) replacing the negative svg-exclusion with a POSITIVE allowlist of concrete-safe image subtypes (png/jpeg/gif/webp) — anything not enumerated (including any future SVG-like/unknown subtype) is denied by construction. 12 new regression tests added (files-http.test.ts: 6 param/no-+xml bypass cases, 1 xhtml+xml, 2 param-stripping-not-over-broad positives on png/pdf, 3 positive-allowlist coverage jpeg/gif/webp; screen-record-detail.test.jsx: 1 behavioral test with 12 assertions, 1 existing assertion updated for the new normalizedMime literal). AC-9/AC-15 residual: the vitest web tier is a documented, intentional 'node' environment with NO jsdom (web/vitest.config.js: 'no jsdom overhead, honest') and neither jsdom nor react-test-renderer is installed. Verified empirically that calling a hooks-bearing component function directly throws ('Invalid hook call') — so FileFieldValue's/FileCell's/FileField's async fetch→setState transitions cannot be exercised end-to-end at the unit level without adding a new dependency (judged out of proportion for a fix-forward pass given the repo's zero-dep-growth culture).
